description: Parity fixture for the closed row-rule grammar (integration contract §2.1). Read by packages/domain/test/vcrRules.test.mjs and by the engine case N00 (tests/numeric/N00_protocol.R). `valid` cases carry a rule, the table columns, rows (objects; a column is the same JSON type in every row, null is missing) and one verdict per row: "TRUE", "FALSE" or "NA". `invalid` cases carry a rule with exactly one defect, the table columns, the issue code and the path of the defect, relative to the rule root ("" is the root). A non-finite number is written 1e999, which JSON.parse and jsonlite both read as infinity.
